title: Respondent
summary: RESPOND'ENT, adjective Answering; that answers to demand or expectation. - Wealth respondent to payment and contributions. RESPOND'ENT, noun 1. One that answers in a suit, particularly a chancery suit

inlines.v: RESPOND'ENT, adjective Answering; that answers to demand or expectation. - Wealth respondent to payment and contributions. RESPOND'ENT, noun 1. One that answers in a suit, particularly a chancery suit. 2. In the schools, one who maintains a thesis in reply, and whose province is to refute objections or overthrow arguments.
